events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: On August 1, 1981, MTV launched in the US, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember when music television changed everything? Forty-five years ago today, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off with a truly prophetic song.

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album, "Definitely Maybe," in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' on the world. Still sounds as fresh and defiant as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Spirit
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. What a moment in history.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album "Abbey Road" in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the tracks within!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still sounding brilliant.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very Happy Birthday. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK in 1975, though the album came out in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album first asked us to envision a world of peace. A message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed how we carried our music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Six decades since 007 first hit the big screen. Which Bond theme gets your vote as the best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental "White Album". What a masterpiece.
